title: Find Maximum Number of String Pairs
summary: Given an array of distinct strings, find the maximum number of pairs where one string is the reverse of another, ensuring each string is used in at most one pair.
statement: Given an array of distinct strings, find the maximum number of pairs where one string is the reverse of another, ensuring each string is used in at most one pair.
constraints: Every word contains exactly two lowercase letters.
Pair two unused indices when one word equals the reverse of the other.
Return the maximum number of disjoint pairs.
reference_solution:
def maximum_reversed_word_pairs(words):
    waiting={};answer=0
    for word in words:
        reverse=word[::-1]
        if waiting.get(reverse,0):waiting[reverse]-=1;answer+=1
        else:waiting[word]=waiting.get(word,0)+1
    return answer

hints: For each new word, consume one unmatched reverse when available; otherwise store the new word.
Increment the answer on every successful consumption.
Matching immediately cannot hurt because all copies of a two-letter word have the same only compatible reverse type.
